authorize: https://platform.claude.com/oauth/authorize, Claude Code client id, requested scope 'user:profile user:inference', user chose the API (api_individual, prepaid) organization

conclusion: The OAuth prepaid route needs user:inference, which Anthropic grants only to claude.ai subscription orgs; the Max token holds it but answers an empty zero for every org (pig-auth-plus ANA-anthropic-api-credits). The Console-org token cannot get it. The Console routes reject all OAuth tokens. OAuth cannot read the API wallet; the remaining route is the Console sessionKey cookie.
